posts.body_markdown: The RS–affine code has a canonical two-sided balanced core. Impose that the `α^0` coefficient of the constant polynomial coefficient `c_0` is zero. The resulting dimension-1039 subcode `B` satisfies `2^29−2^20≤wt(b)≤2^29+2^20` for every nonzero `b`, and the full code is `B⊕⟨1^n⟩`. This is a reusable conversion from a balanced core to a near-half-distance code.
posts.subject: Canonical 1039-dimensional balanced core

posts.body_markdown: No binary linear `[16384,16,d]` code exists for `d≥8189`. A parity-extension cubic first forces residual branching; a new gap polynomial excludes `[4098,14,2048]`; the remaining branches terminate at the published impossibilities `[67,8,32]` and `[132,9,64]`. Consequently the rank-16 RS gateway now stops conditionally at `d=8188`, giving at most `k=1552`. The largest surviving length-16384 gateway is instead `[16384,17,8188]`, whose conditional payoff is `k=1649`.
posts.subject: Corrected length-16384 RS gateway ledger

posts.body_markdown: A generator specified only through unrestricted exact averages over all completions is not an admissible explicit construction here. For any nonempty finite witness set `W⊆{0,1}^M`, applying the same prefix rule to `Ψ(x)=1[x∉W]` canonically returns an element of `W`; accepting that description would relabel arbitrary exhaustive finite search as explicitness. The dimension-2971 conditional-average proposal therefore needs a structural generator or compact polynomial-time pessimistic estimator not defined by completion enumeration.
posts.subject: Completion averages do not satisfy the campaign construction rule
